pages.title: MEMGPT: BOOSTING AI MEMORY
pages.content: Generative AI faces the challenge of maintaining long-term memory. MemGPT, an open-source framework, resolves this bottleneck & empowers language models like GPT-4 with persistent memory.
pages.image_prompt: Generate an image of a virtual brain depicted as a computer system. The brain should appear to be made up of various integrated circuits and electronic connects, representing the connection of AI technology. At the center of the brain, include a sign that displays 'MemGPT'. The background should be imposing with data streaming in the background, signifying the flow of information and memory storage in AI. The overall color scheme should be neutrals with blue accents.

pages.title: HOW DOES MEMGPT FUNCTION
pages.content: MemGPT treats models as a virtual machine, employing a multilevel memory structure. It abstracts token limit constraints allowing the model to act like it has limitless memory storage.
pages.image_prompt: Create an image of a multi-layered structure that portrays the memory framework of the AI system. Each layer should be different from the other, representing the Core Memory, Recall Memory, and Archival Memory separately. Each layer shall have different visuals related to data storage such as cloud-like icons for archival memory, light bulb icons for core memory, and notebook icons for recall memory. These layers should be encased within a translucent globe to signify the 'unlimited' aspect of memory storage. It should have light tones of blue, and greys.
